objective: Preallocate Fusion storage SSTable handle lists for the first loaded SSTable.

tasks.title: Preallocate SSTable handle list
tasks.result: Fusion storage startup now creates its loaded SSTable handle list with capacity for the first opened SSTable.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The loaded SSTable handle list capacity is 1 because the first successfully opened SSTable is immediately pushed into the list.
The optimization only changes initial Vec allocation for loaded SSTable handles; candidate scanning, SSTable opening, active memtable id selection, and timestamp restore semantics are unchanged.
